summary: Master Project Controls, Cost and Schedule Management with EVM, CPM, and WBS. 5-day intermediate training for Project Managers and Cost Engineers.
lede: Project controls connects cost, schedule, and performance information so project teams can track delivery and respond to variances. Designed for project managers, schedulers, cost engineers, and project controllers, the training covers building work breakdown structures and critical-path schedules, setting cost and schedule baselines, and measuring performance with earned value metrics. Participants also practice change control, risk analysis, variance reporting, and executive dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate professionals who understand basic project terminology but need to master integrated cost-schedule controls to drive performance and accountability.
modules: Schedule Development and Critical Path Analysis
Schedule Health Checks and Acceleration Strategies
Digital Tools and AI in Project Controls
Advanced Project Controls and Forensic Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with project management terminology (activities, milestones, budgets) and working knowledge of Excel. No coding or advanced software experience is necessary as hands-on training with Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project is provided. A laptop is recommended for exercises.
